children: Innovative Industrial Properties added Huntington as a sales agent and forward counterparty under its $500,000,000 ATM program after Jefferies terminated its agreement.
Jefferies' equity distribution agreement was terminated on Aug. 31, 2026; no further sales will occur under that agreement.
Company entered an additional equity distribution agreement with Huntington on Aug. 31, 2026 as sales agent and potential forward seller/purchaser.
Aggregate offering capacity for common stock and 9.00% Series A preferred remains up to $500,000,000 under the ATM Prospectus.
Shares will be offered pursuant to the Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-285148) and the ATM prospectus as supplemented through Aug. 31, 2026.
